keys.hwy.businessRules.page.lead: This page documents enforced rules in the Hawiety package (not backup/restore). Update when domain logic changes.
keys.hwy.businessRules.error.loadList: Could not load the rules index.
keys.hwy.businessRules.section.membership-num: Which identifier is the public tracking code vs the التياري membership number (UserName) shown in staff lists and used for login.
keys.hwy.businessRules.section.username-reser: Pool table hwy_username_repo: when numbers are consumed, concurrency, and dossier timeline — not self-reg submit.
keys.hwy.businessRules.section.self-registrat: Public applicant submit: validation parity with HWY_Members_New plus tracking-code semantics (member id).
keys.hwy.businessRules.section.identity-masks: Legacy HashPhones and HashPhonesForOthers (HWY_Members.cs): viewer gender limits, institute ownership, dossier edit locks, and API surfaces that apply the same rules.
keys.hwy.businessRules.section.targhin.title: Targhin requests
keys.hwy.businessRules.section.targhin.intro: Withdrawal requests, decisions, and negotiation notes.
keys.hwy.businessRules.section.member-list-le: Toolbar mode 2 (legacy field panel) on Hawiety people lists: row order, membership-id search modes, join-tasjil filter, and server WHERE parity.
keys.hwy.businessRules.section.employees-list: Studio HWY_Employees_List parity: legacy Read_Employees access, dbo.hwy_employees_list_* reads, and directory identity masks on rows.
keys.hwy.businessRules.section.membership-app: Call-center and local verification (Waited_1 / Waited_2): status transitions, activation side effects, and dbo.hwy_membership_apply_* only.
keys.hwy.businessRules.section.nakhebin-linki: Voter link wizard parity through hwy_member_nakhebin_* procedures and Geographic Divisions ids.
keys.hwy.businessRules.section.geo-responsibi: Studio geo responsibility replaces H_Circle_* / H_Eghtera_* legacy suggest-approve SPs — single path at cutover.
keys.hwy.businessRules.section.electoral-tree: One person may hold several roles. Process-path officials get exactly one node; direct assignment (employees list role + region) may attach several nodes on the same level — never two levels at once.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.membership-tracki: Public self-registration tracking is always hwy_members.id (no hwy_tracking_codes table). Staff «membership number» / login UserName is hwy_members.username (COALESCE with base_users.username in vw_hwy_members) and stays empty until local verification approves to active — the tracking id is not substituted into that column.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.membership-displa: Legacy ETL and resolveLegacyMemberUsername prefer imported UserName, else legacy TrackingCode on the row. Greenfield pending rows have no التياري until activation; vw_hwy_members.tracking_code exposes member id for search/filters only. Never synthesize m{memberId} or other fake serials for the membership-number column.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.membership-no-syn: Import and repair scripts must not invent a التياري from member id when both legacy UserName and TrackingCode are empty. Runtime lists read username from the member/user join — not auto-generated from id.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.membership-view-c: Directory username is COALESCE(trim(hwy_members.username), base_users.username) so linked login accounts show the platform username when the member row is blank.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.membership-legacy: Legacy assigned UserName only on approval (HWY_SP_Members_2_Approve), not on first save. AppEndO mirrors that: hwy_self_registration_create_member does not touch hwy_username_repo; dbo.hwy_membership_apply_local_decision (approve → active) allocates from the repo and links base_users when user_id was null.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.username-repo-uni: hwy_username_repo.username is UNIQUE system-wide. reserved_at is set when a row is tied to a member at activation; released_at optional when a number is returned to the pool.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.username-repo-all: Only local approve (pending_local → active) selects TOP 1 from hwy_username_repo WHERE member_id IS NULL AND released_at IS NULL ORDER BY NEWID() with UPDLOCK, READPAST — same random-pick intent as legacy repo flags. Operators must seed free rows for new activations; ETL often pre-links member_id for migrated members.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.username-repo-mem: On successful allocation, repo.member_id is set to the activated member and hwy_members.username matches repo.username. ON DELETE SET NULL on member_id keeps historical rows.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.username-repo-act: Local approve with no existing user_id requires a bcrypt password_hash from the app (57106 if missing). Empty pool → 57107. Concurrent claim on the same repo row → 57108. API maps these to operator-facing errors; no silent fallback number.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.username-repo-ski: If hwy_members.user_id is already set (typical after ETL), local approve only updates membership status and membership_on — no second repo pick and no duplicate base_users insert.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.username-repo-cha: After activation, dossier change log reads base_record_events on the member and shows registration.usernameReserved at reserved_at — not at self-reg submit.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.selfreg-tracking-: Successful self-reg returns trackingCode = CAST(member_id AS NVARCHAR(32)). dbo.hwy_member_after_create / resend SMS use the same value in template tokens. POST track-by-code resolves status via hwy_members.id (numeric or string), not a separate tracking table.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.selfreg-identity-: first name, father, grandfather, and family name are required on submit (same keys as dossier edit validation).
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.selfreg-national-: When filled, national ID must be exactly 12 digits (Iraqi unified number).
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.selfreg-birth-yea: Four-digit birth year between 1919 and the current calendar year.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.selfreg-phone.bod: Phone1 is required; digits only, 11 characters, must start with 07. Phone2 optional with same format.
Optional referrer username: exactly 6 digits when complete; partial input invalid once typing starts.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.selfreg-institute: Optional institute invitation code: 3 digits when provided.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.dossier-note-read: hwy_members.note is never editable in dossier edit mode (HWY_MEMBER_DOSSIER_NEVER_EDITABLE_MEMBER_FIELDS).
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.dossier-staff-not: Internal commentary uses hwy_member_notes with subject codes — not the public note column.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.dossier-edit-sect: Nested edit URLs allow only basic data (default) and files satellite; institute membership is workflow-managed elsewhere.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.dossier-validatio: Studio dossier edit reuses self-registration rules for gender, birth year, province/district, phones, email, and education years.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.mask-gender-limit: Viewer limits come from session serverContext keys: user.gender_limits, user.hwy_gender_limits, user.GenderLimits, user.gender_view, user.hwy.gender_view, role.gender_limits, role.hwy_gender_limits, role.hwy.gender_view (JSON array or legacy Id objects). When still empty, SQL loads dbo.HWY_Members_GenderLimits for the staff row linked via hwy_members.user_id. isAdmin or genderLimitLegacyIds.length ≥ 2 → no gender mask (legacy JWT GenderLimits count ≥ 2).
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.mask-gender-id-ma: Member and viewer genders normalize to legacy ids 10011 (male) and 10012 (female) from genderCode values such as 100.1.1 / 100.1.2 or Base Info titles. Comparison uses the first allowed id when only one limit applies.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.mask-gender-phone: When a single gender limit applies and member gender differs: firstname → ***** (HWY_MEMBER_IDENTITY_MASK_SENTINEL), non-empty phone1/phone2 → *****, avatarUrl/profile image fields cleared and hasProfileImage false (legacy client picture hide). Runs in applyHwyMemberIdentityFieldMasksToRows after directory enrichment.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.mask-unknown-gend: Legacy treats empty GenderId as not matching the allowed gender. AppEndO masks phones and first name when genderCode is missing or unmappable under a single-gender viewer limit.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.mask-visible-line: Legacy HashPhones masks FirstName and phones only — not family name, father name, username, or tracking code. AppEndO dossier and lists keep the same lineage/username fields readable unless another rule applies.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.mask-display-full: Directory list rows also set displayFullName to ***** when the gender mask applies (stricter than legacy FirstName-only, same privacy intent for grid title column).
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.mask-execution-or: Same as legacy: HashPhones first, then HashPhonesForOthers. Institute phone substitution can replace phone1/phone2 even after gender stars.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.mask-institute-me: approvedRestrictedOrgsCount counts hwy_member_institutes rows with member_accepted = 1, active membership status_code from list scope, and institute_id in {4, 214917, 215103}. orgsMembership STRING_AGG uses titles of all approved institute links on the member (legacy OrgsMembership aggregate).
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.mask-institute-ph: When approvedRestrictedOrgsCount > 0, phone1 = orgsMembership summary, phone2 empty. Skipped for ADMIN or legacy role ids 1000006 / 1000040 (also platform role name mapping). Bypass roles use substring parity with legacy rls.Contains in JWT roles JSON.
Dossier view/edit shows an institute membership banner when identityFieldPolicy.institutePhoneMasked is true and orgsMembershipSummary is present on the loaded member row.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.mask-patch-lock.b: getOne attaches identityFieldPolicy. Gender mask locks firstname, phone1, phone2, genderCode; institute mask locks phone1/phone2. Server strips locked fields on PATCH; dossier edit form shows read-only fields and omits locked keys on submit.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.mask-photo-readon: personalPhotoReadOnly when gender-masked. UI disables personal_photo edit; POST /api/hwy/member-directory/:id/files rejects personal_photo with 403 when policy forbids upload.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.mask-apply-surfac: applyHwyMemberIdentityFieldMasksToRows with viewer session: vw-hwy-members member-directory list/getOne (getOne also attaches identityFieldPolicy), PATCH /api/hwy/member-directory/:id policy strip, org-membership-transfer search, similar-members SP results (genderCode column), member-picker search, profile-nav similar count. List rows are masked but do not ship identityFieldPolicy to the grid client.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.mask-list-cache-v: Directory list GET cache uses cacheByUser (metadata + ensureHwyMemberDirectoryListRuntime pin; dataApiRuntimePolicy forces byUser for vw-hwy-members.hwy-member-directory-list) because masked phones and names depend on the viewer, not only query params.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.mask-deferred-sho: Legacy list HTML used shared.showPhones to reveal starred phones after click. AppEndO V2 does not implement that UX yet; masked values stay ***** / org text until a future list interaction rule is added.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.files-registratio: File kinds split into registration documents (personal photo, ID cards, oath, etc.) and other attachments with separate edit/delete capabilities.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.files-kind-approv: Core registration kinds use hwy_member_files.is_approved; other_attachment is not approval-gated in the catalog.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.files-registratio: Legacy UpdatePicturesApproveFlags maps to dbo.hwy_member_registration_files_sync_approve_flags (personal photo, national card front/back, voter card front, residence card front) — mutation in SQL, not inline app updates. POST /api/hwy/members/:id/registration-files/sync-approve-flags and dossier files edit approval panel.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.course-status-dra: New courses start in draft status code 215114 (HWY_COURSE_STATUS_DRAFT).
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.course-send-revie: From draft, send-to-review requires more than one course attendee (memberCount > 1) and moves to review queue 215115.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.course-review-act: In status 215115: mark-as-ok → 215116 approved; send-to-draft returns to 215114; send-to-marfoozeh → 215117 rejected. Un-reject from 215117 back to 215115.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.course-workflow-n: Returning to draft or rejecting (marfoozeh) requires an operator note (UI + workflow parity).
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.activity-status-r: Activities in status 211311 (register) appear in the registration admin queue excluding central type 213915 when filtered.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.activity-image-li: send-to-waited-1 requires at least one activity file and at most four images; otherwise the action is hidden or rejected server-side.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.activity-workflow: 211311 register → 211312 initial documentation → 211313 final documentation → 211314 completed. Return to register from 211312/211313 with note. Reject from final doc to 211315 marfoozeh.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.activity-marfooze: send-to-un-marfoozeh from 211315 restores final documentation queue 211313.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.self-announce-win: Self-announcement must be enabled, activity not completed, and current time within nbWindowStartAt / nbWindowEndAt when those are set.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.self-announce-met: Member must supply GPS lat/lon and selfie; device OS/id/datetime recorded or required per policy.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.self-announce-cen: Central activity type 213915 (or explicit requireSubmissionDeviceMetadata) mandates device fields, not optional record-only.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.targhin-queues.bo: Primary path: create request (hwy_targhin_create_request) + admin decide (hwy_targhin_decide_request). Direct apply/remove is documented under targhin-direct-sp — not a second TS mutation path.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.targhin-reason-vo: Approve reasons from Base Info parent 212130; reject reasons from parent 212170 — both required on final decision.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.targhin-nego-note: Adding a targhin note in dossier requires at least 20 characters; nego thread uses legacy actor username resolution.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.org-transfer-inst: Only configured institutes (hemam, mehani, ashaaer, mithaaq, nokhab, alforat) expose org transfer request actions.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.org-transfer-role: Each institute maps to a legacy request role (e.g. HWY_R_1000079 for hemam); ADMIN bypasses and can act for all. Member search results for transfer use the same identity masks as the directory (see identity-masks).
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.list-defs-institu: listLogicCode institute binds a nav list to hwy_institutes.id and member_institutes membership rules.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.list-defs-predica: Predicate lists reference predicateRef (legacy SQL/view name) for conditional member sets such as waited queues or targhin status. Waited_1 / Waited_2 map to membership_status_code filters — actions are documented under membership-approval-pipeline.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.membership-sp-dec: Call center and local decisions mutate membership_status_code only through hwy_membership_apply_call_center_decision and hwy_membership_apply_local_decision (/api/hwy/membership/*). No multi-step membership SQL in Node services.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.membership-status: Call center: approve pending_call_center → pending_local; reject → rejected_call_center; unreject → pending_call_center. Local: approve pending_local → active (sets membership_on and, when user_id is null, allocates username + base_users in the same transaction); reject_final → rejected_local_verification; reject_returnable → rejected_local; unreject from rejected_* → pending_local. Status codes are Base Info short names (Membership Status).
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.membership-local-: When activation runs, Node generates a random five-digit password, hashes it with bcrypt, and passes password_hash to dbo.hwy_membership_apply_local_decision. The procedure inserts base_users (username from repo, placeholder email member-{id}@member.hawiety.local, mobile from phone1). Plain password is not returned on the decision API — legacy activation SMS with @UserName/@Password is not wired yet; assign member platform roles separately if required.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.membership-change: Field history uses platform record events + hwy_member_directory_patch / dossier change log — legacy Members_LogChanges is not duplicated.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.membership-decisi: Reject requires a Base Info reason (Membership Call Center / Local Approve or Reject Reason categories) plus a mandatory explanation. The note is stored on hwy_member_notes with subject call_center or local_verification; membership status changes emit platform record events (not Members_LogChanges).
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.membership-after-: After self-registration files are saved, dbo.hwy_member_after_create mirrors applicant note into hwy_member_notes (membership subject), assigns channel institute auto-join when configured, sets tosigh_confirm_code, builds legacy template 111255 SMS with tracking token = member id, and the server sends via platform sendSms (subject 111225). Resend uses hwy_member_after_create_resend + POST /api/hwy/membership/:id/resend-registration-sms. This hook does not allocate التياري or create base_users.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.membership-dossie: Waited_1 / Waited_2 designer lists filter by membership_status_code; approve/reject also appear as a Review column on waited list grids. Full actions (unreject, nakhebin family/eghtera/roghe/addr, kasb, institute invite) run from the member dossier (decision dialog: reason combo + required note on reject).
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.membership-ops-de: B11 approval-flow dashboard stats: not shipped (read proc optional later). B10 legacy member id link: dbo.hwy_member_legacy_identity_link — cutover/ETL only, no day-to-day Studio UI.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.nakhebin-sp-famil: Link, family, eghtera, clear, change roghe (nakhebin_link_region_id), and set_addr_eghtera are dbo.hwy_member_nakhebin_* / hwy_member_set_addr_eghtera — invoked from /api/hwy/member-nakhebin/*.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.nakhebin-link-typ: nakhebin_link_type_code references Base Info Nakhebin Link Type (ballot, family, electoral_center, …). Default ballot on simple link; family link sets family_code; eghtera link sets electoral_center type.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.nakhebin-dossier-: Read-only nakhebin panels on dossier view; nakhebin section exposes ballot/family/eghtera link, clear, change roghe, and set electoral address via /api/hwy/member-nakhebin/* (no inline TS field patch).
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.nakhebin-no-logch: Nakhebin mutations emit the same member field history as dossier patch (nakhebin_id, link type, region, family_code).
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.targhin-direct-sp: Targhin without a request (legacy MakeTarghinById) is not offered. Admin remove-from-dossier uses hwy_targhin_remove_direct; apply uses the request + decide_request path only.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.org-transfer-roll: Org membership invite rollback uses dbo.hwy_org_membership_transfer_rollback (DELETE hwy_member_institutes row) via /api/hwy/org-membership-transfer/.../rollback — same MERGE contract as request.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.org-institute-inv: Legacy SuggestForOrg / MakeMemberOfOrg: pending row from hwy_org_membership_transfer_request; member accept/reject via hwy_member_institute_respond_invite (member_accepted, institute status active/removed).
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.org-employment-cl: RemoveEmployeement maps to hwy_member_institute_clear_employment on hwy_member_institutes.current_org_employment_* (General Assembly row).
AddKasb maps to hwy_member_kasb_link — stores kasb member username on second_referrer_username with optional referrer_relation_id.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.role-electoral-mu: One member MAY hold several operational roles at once (different role_name / official slots / access bundles). Role count is not limited by this contract.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.role-electoral-si: Process path — geo responsibility nominations for specific official roles: exactly one node (legacy_geo_id + geo_base_info_id) per member on that path; moves via nomination / removal, not a second branch. Direct path — employees list role + region assignment (legacy direct parity): MAY assign multiple approved nodes on the same geo_level only. Every member still has at most one geo_level among active approved anchors — never province and circle (or any two levels) at once.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.role-electoral-ou: Plain membership without an electoral-tree role; nakhebin electoral join on the dossier (membership geography, not official anchoring); institute org membership unless product explicitly binds that role to a geo node.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.role-electoral-en: dbo.hwy_member_area_limits may list several approved rows for one member when direct / employees assignment placed multiple nodes on the same level — expected, not drift. Cross-level approved rows are drift: legacy-edge parity and geo-responsibility ETL skip them (hwyMemberAreaLimitsCrossLevelEtl). New writes MUST block cross-level anchors. npm run schema:area-limits-invariant fails on cross-level counts; npm run hwy:etl:purge-cross-level-area-limits removes drift already on edge.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.list-legacy-filte: Every Hawiety member-directory people list whose legacy scope starts with HWY_Members_List_ uses HwyMemberDirectoryLegacyFieldByFieldPanel when the legacy field toggle is on — except quick-search picker AlMontadhemin_SingleView. Wizard pickers (similar-members bar, etc.) keep their own compact filters.

Row 1 = page logic (All People: membership status checkboxes; Montadhemin: institute multi-filter; image-fix: queue filters). Row 2 = identity (gender → membership id → phone → four name fields). Row 3 = personal details (join-tasjil state → national id → birth year). Row 4 = education/work selects. Row 5 = electoral center cascade (memberRashh parity). Optional extraRows below for list-specific dates/flags.

Per list, membershipIdentifierSearchMode is username, trackingCode, or usernameOrTrackingCode (All People default). usernameOrTrackingCode writes the same value to gridToolbar.legacy.username and trackingCode; list API ORs when both match. Server: buildHwyMemberDirectoryListLegacyFilterWhere.

Row 3 select hwy.members.legacyFilter.joinTasjilState maps registered_biometric / unregistered to Base Info ids on nakhebin_join_tasjil_state_code. Store gridToolbar.filters.nakhebinJoinTasjilStateCode; API filter[nakhebinJoinTasjilStateCode][eq]; fast path hwyMemberDirectoryListFastPath when only this filter is active.

Legacy toolbar keys and gridToolbar.filters.* compile to SQL via hwyMemberDirectoryListLegacyFilterWhere.service and list scope rules in hwyMemberDirectoryListScope.service. Identity masks still run after enrichment (applyHwyMemberIdentityFieldMasksToRows) — filters do not bypass HashPhones.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.employees-list-ac: pageKey hwy-employees-list. Route middleware resolves allow roles from legacy HWY_Members.Read_Employees via fetchLegacyPlatformRolesByAction; ADMIN always allowed. Fallback to ADMIN when legacy role DB is unreachable.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.employees-list-re: SQL Server: dbo.hwy_employees_list_read and hwy_employees_list_count with params from buildHwyEmployeesListProcParams (legacy filter mapping). When legacy import parity is not ready, falls back to queryLegacyEmployeesList* against the legacy DB. List scope legacy hint HWY_Members_List_AlMontadhemin for enrichment.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.employees-list-ma: Rows pass through enrichHwyMemberDirectoryListRows then the same viewer gender / institute masks as member directory lists. Limit columns (rolesLimits, areasLimits, genderLimits, orgLimits, …) are display-only legacy parity fields on the grid.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.geo-resp-studio-p: Nomination, approval, removal, and official access use hwy_geo_responsibility_* procedures and hwy_geo_responsibility_requests — not legacy per-level H_* SP writes.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.geo-legacy-sp-ret: H_Circle_*, H_Tamvin_*, H_Eghtera_*, H_Mohafezat_*, H_Mahatteh_*, H_Ghavateh_* suggest/approve/remove SPs and ChangeMasooliatPlace / UpdateFlags are retired at cutover — Studio geo responsibility is the only write path.
keys.hwy.businessRules.rule.geo-officials-rep: Legacy Masoolin_TopOfficials / BelowOfficials read/report SPs are not ported in Phase 1; optional read procs or reports may follow later.
